title: Made-in-China Product & Supplier Finder Input
description: Find unique Made-in-China suppliers using product keywords, uploaded product images, or public image URLs. Choose one search mode and provide the matching inputs. Fields for the other mode are ignored.

searchMode.title: Search mode
searchMode.description: Choose keyword search for product terms or image search for product photos.

searchTerms.title: Product keywords
searchTerms.description: Used in keyword mode. Add one specific product query per row, such as stainless steel glass shower hinge.
searchTerms.sectionDescription: These fields are used only when Search mode is Keyword search.

maxUniqueSuppliersPerKeyword.title: Maximum suppliers per keyword
maxUniqueSuppliersPerKeyword.description: Maximum number of unique suppliers returned separately for each product keyword.

maxPagesText.title: Maximum pages per keyword
maxPagesText.description: Maximum number of Made-in-China result pages processed for each keyword.

uploadedImages.title: Product images
uploadedImages.description: Used in image mode. Upload up to 20 clear JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, or BMP product images. WebP and GIF files are converted automatically because Made-in-China accepts JPG, PNG, and BMP uploads. Each image is searched separately.
uploadedImages.sectionDescription: These fields are used only when Search mode is Image search.

imageUrls.title: Public product image URLs
imageUrls.description: Used in image mode and recommended for API or MCP clients. Add direct, publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS image URLs. The combined upload and URL limit is 20 images.

maxUniqueSuppliersPerImage.title: Maximum suppliers per image
maxUniqueSuppliersPerImage.description: Maximum number of unique suppliers returned separately for each image.

maxPagesImage.title: Maximum result batches per image
maxPagesImage.description: Each Made-in-China image-search batch contains up to 20 products. The website currently provides at most five batches.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
useApifyProxy.description: Recommended for more reliable access when Made-in-China limits direct traffic.
useApifyProxy.sectionDescription: Shared behavior for keyword and image searches.

includeSupplierDetails.title: Include supplier profile details
includeSupplierDetails.description: Visit each accepted public supplier profile to add business type, main products, location, establishment year, employee count, address, member history, rating, and response time. Disable for faster runs.

skipFailedImages.title: Skip failed images
skipFailedImages.description: Continue with the remaining images if one image cannot be downloaded, uploaded, or searched.

failOnNoResults.title: Fail when no results are found
failOnNoResults.description: When enabled, fail the run if no usable supplier rows are produced. Otherwise, finish with a warning and diagnostic files.

saveCsvFile.title: Save CSV files
saveCsvFile.description: Save CSV files to the run's key-value store in addition to the structured dataset.
saveCsvFile.sectionDescription: Optional file exports. Dataset output is always available.

csvOutputMode.title: CSV output mode
csvOutputMode.description: Save one combined CSV, separate files for each keyword or image, or both.

csvFilename.title: Combined CSV filename
csvFilename.description: Filename used when a combined CSV is requested.
